recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, square-format photograph of a crouching figure, heavily color-graded with a cyan/teal wash, framed by a thick black border that creates a wide letterbox effect.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure is anchored by a symmetrical crouching pose.
The vibrant cyan background contrasts sharply with the deep black outer frame.
Warm skin tones are suppressed by the dominant cool-toned color overlay.
Vertical light streaks in the background provide a sense of depth and texture.
coreInvariants: Thick black border on all four sides.
Dominant cyan/teal color cast over the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the inner square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure's hands held near the face create a central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright center, moves down to the heavy boots, and then expands outward to the black void of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the thick black outer border.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan range with crushed blacks in the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit warm colors to tiny highlight areas

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the bottom black margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for utilitarian metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the metadata text.
Provides a clean, professional look for small-scale metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of a person in a crouching pose with urban clothing. Apply a heavy cyan/teal duotone filter. Place this square in the center of a larger black square canvas to create thick borders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, white, condensed sans-serif text centered in the bottom black margin.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a perfect square?
Is the cyan color cast consistent across the inner image?
Is the text centered in the bottom black border?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the cyan color wash
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand-identifying marks on clothing
The exact wording of the metadata text

avoid: Soft or blurry edges on the frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black border is uniform in color.
Check that the cyan tint does not wash out all detail in the subject.
Verify the text is legible but small.
Confirm the square aspect ratio of the inner image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square urban portrait + Cyan duotone filter + Thick black letterbox frame + Small centered bottom-margin metadata.
